scope: These checks verify source integration. They do not prove a release or a live installation.

Keep one crate job for each package.
Keep image publication and affected selection changes.
Keep separate environment variables for the host build.
Keep the existing fixture pins. Add new tool and action records.
Keep exact upstream diagnostic logs as external evidence. Remove them from source.
